tabs.html:
Juniper Modular Interface Card MIC-3D-2XGE-XFP – Dual 10GbE XFP Ports for MX80 & MX104 Routers

Unlock high-performance networking with the Juniper MIC-3D-2XGE-XFP Modular Interface Card, designed for MX80 and MX104 routers. This powerful card features 2x 10GbE XFP ports, enabling reliable, high-bandwidth connectivity for demanding enterprise and service provider networks. Ideal for data centers, cloud applications, and large-scale deployments, the MIC-3D-2XGE-XFP offers exceptional scalability and low-latency performance, making it an essential addition to your Juniper networking infrastructure.

Key Features:

  • Dual 10GbE XFP ports for fast, high-throughput connections
  • Designed for seamless integration with MX80 and MX104 routers
  • Hot-swappable for easy installation and upgrades without downtime
  • Ideal for high-bandwidth applications such as cloud, data center, and edge networks
  • Supports a wide range of network configurations for maximum flexibility
